title: Arquiteto de Soluções Júnior em Produtos Digitais - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo , busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução.

A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa.

Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio.

A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA.

Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia.

O que você vai encontrar aqui:

• Ambiente de aprendizado acelerado em arquitetura de tecnologia

• Exposição a produtos digitais de grande escala

• Contato próximo com times de produto, engenharia e arquitetura

• Desenvolvimento de visão técnica e de negócio

Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de trabalho : Híbrido - São Paulo/SP ou Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar a evolução da arquitetura de soluções e integrações do domínio de Produtos Digitais;
  • Contribuir na elaboração de diagramas arquiteturais (blocos, camadas e integrações);
  • Apoiar o mapeamento de sistemas, fluxos de informação e integrações;
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia e produto na compreensão das soluções existentes;
  • Auxiliar na aplicação de padrões e boas práticas de arquitetura;
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e apoiar análises de solução;
  • Apoiar a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria nas soluções.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento em áreas de tecnologia;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou tecnologia (≈ 1 a 3 anos);
  • Conhecimento básico de APIs (REST) e arquitetura de sistemas;
  • Noções de sistemas distribuídos e microserviços;
  • Interesse em arquitetura de software e sistemas;
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Familiaridade com linguagens como JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js ou backend (Python, Java, Go, etc.);
  • Conhecimento básico de boas práticas de engenharia de software (ex: design patterns, organização de código).

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Vivência em times de produto digital;
  • Interesse por temas como arquitetura, plataformas digitais e ecossistemas de mídia.

Informações adicionais

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota. #vempraglobo

Somos um fabricante global de materiais de construção e, dentro do nosso Grupo, nossos 41.500 membros da equipe em 90 países em 300 locais oferecem uma grande oportunidade para qualquer pessoa com ambição e energia. Nossos valores corporativos são nossa âncora, garantia de nosso sucesso. Desta vez estamos procurando Especificador para atuar com o produto Aquapanel em Brasília.

O que você irá fazer?

Divulgar e promover os produtos da empresa, mediante visitas periódicas às empresas de projeto e clientes como Construtoras, Escritórios de Arquitetura, Instaladores e Projetistas. Garantir a conversão técnica de projetos em especificação de produtos e, posteriormente, em vendas.

  • Manter-se atualizado tecnicamente sobre os lançamentos de mercado, produtos e normas técnicas, bem como concorrência e produtos da empresa
  • Participar de eventos pertinentes à sua área de atuação, visando divulgar a imagem da empresa.
  • Realizar Treinamento com as equipes de projeto e especificação
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e comerciais com foco em especificação
  • Ser referência para avaliação, qualificação e desenvolvimento de leads de especificação

O que gostaríamos que tivesse?

Estamos interessados em suas atitudes, comportamentos e valores. Contanto que você esteja disposto a aprender qualquer coisa que você precisa para o cargo que você ainda não tem, nós adoraríamos falar com você. Se você tem experiência nas seguintes áreas, é uma vantagem adicional:

Ensino Superior Completo em Arquitetura ou Engenharia Civil.

Experiência em áreas relativas a projetos de construção a seco e/ou atuação geral na área de projetos para construção civil.

Conhecimentos específicos: Pacote Office; AutoCAD; SketchUp; Sistemas de Construção a Seco.

Possuir CNH e disponibilidade para viagens em 50% do tempo

Experiência na área de vendas técnicas será considerado um diferencial.

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Gympass
  • Seguro de vida
  • E como ferramentas de trabalho: carro, computador e celular.

O que vem agora?

Entendemos que o seu tempo é valioso e que a candidatura a um novo emprego pode ser um processo demorado, por isso nos comprometemos a responder à sua solicitação.

Estamos comprometidos com um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo e, portanto, tomamos todas as decisões de pessoal em todas as áreas da nossa empresa com base na experiência, habilidades e integridade. Incentivamos candidatos de todas as esferas da vida a se candidatarem aos nossos cargos, independentemente de idade, sexo, identidade de gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, origem, religião, etc.

The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function.


About the Role


As a Lead IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high‑impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment.


You’ll Be Responsible For



  • Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.

  • Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations.

  • Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows.

  • Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential for a regulated financial environment.

  • Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale.


Mandatory qualifications



  • 7+ years of experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline.

  • Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred.

  • Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function.

  • Hands‑on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end‑to‑end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it.

  • Ability to work cross‑functionally in a fast‑paced, engineering‑led environment, with strong influence‑without‑authority skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to senior leadership.


Nice‑to‑have qualifications



  • Experience in fintech, high‑growth tech, or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with adjacent frameworks: COBIT, ISO 20000, or SRE principles.

  • Experience partnering with Security and/or Platform Engineering teams.


What We Offer



  • Greenfield, high‑visibility scope: you’ll define what “good” ITSM looks like at Nubank’s scale — from zero.

  • Direct exposure to senior leadership across IT and Engineering.

Hybrid – 2–3 times per week in the office.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Sênior (Inspeção) que será responsável pela gestão da integridade e inspeção de dutos e equipamentos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposição de mitigação, garantindo a segurança operacional, a confiabilidade do sistema de transporte e o atendimento às regulamentações vigentes, com foco em Proteção Catódica e desejável conhecimento em NR‑13/SPIE.

Responsabilidades

  • Proteção Catódica: gerenciar e acompanhar sistemas de proteção catódica de dutos, incluindo monitoramento de potenciais, desempenho de retificadores, interferências eletromagnéticas e condições de corrosão externa. Analisar resultados de levantamentos de campo (CIPS, DCVG, PCM/A-Frame, entre outros) e propor ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Inspeção e Integridade: Planejar, acompanhar e aprovar atividades de inspeção e integridade de dutos e equipamentos, com foco em mecanismos de corrosão interna e externa. Avaliar ameaças à integridade (corrosão, interferências, SCC, danos mecânicos, defeitos de fabricação e soldagem).
  • Avaliação de Defeitos: Realizar análises de defeitos com base em normas técnicas (API 579, ASME B31.G, B31.8, entre outras).
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Atualizar e acompanhar KPIs da área, elaborando relatórios técnicos e de suporte ao gestor.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento: Orientar técnicos, promover boas práticas de inspeção e fortalecer a cultura de integridade.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Selecionar, contratar e acompanhar serviços de inspeção e integridade em campo.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.
  • Experiência em proteção catódica, integridade de dutos e desejável NR‑13.
  • Domínio: Proteção Catódica, Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento: NR‑13, SPIE, Avaliação de defeitos (API 579/ASME B31.G), ASME B31.8/B31.8S, PIGs, SCC, soldagem e reparos, ArcGIS/Google Earth, gestão de riscos e contratos.
  • Inglês intermediário (mínimo).

Diferencial

  • Atuação ou disponibilidade para atuar como PLH.
  • Certificações em inspeção/END/soldagem.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Participação em eventos e fóruns técnicos.

Oferecemos

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

title: MECANICO DE AUTOS - ITAVEMA BYD RECREIO Rio de Janeiro - RJ Full-time employee
description:
Descrição da vaga

O Mecânico de Autos é responsável por executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva em veículos, assegurando qualidade, segurança, produtividade e cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos. Atua em diagnósticos mecânicos, elétricos, eletrônicos, híbridos e, quando aplicável, em veículos elétricos a bateria. Deve interpretar manuais técnicos, seguir normas de segurança e ambientais, e utilizar corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos homologados, contribuindo diretamente para a satisfação do cliente e o desempenho do pós-vendas da concessionária.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em veículos BYD conforme ordem de serviço.
  • Efetuar troca de óleo e filtros (óleo do motor, ar do motor, ar-condicionado, combustível).
  • Executar alinhamento e balanceamento de rodas com equipamentos adequados.
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas e eletrônicas utilizando scanner automotivo homologado pela montadora.
  • Executar serviços mecânicos nos sistemas:
  • Suspensão: substituição de amortecedores, bandejas, buchas, molas, pivôs e bieletas.
  • Freios: troca de pastilhas, discos, lonas, tambores, cilindros, sangria do sistema e verificação do fluido.
  • Direção: manutenção de caixas de direção mecânica ou elétrica, terminais e barras de direção.
  • Arrefecimento: troca de bomba d’água, reservatório, válvula termostática, mangueiras e verificação de vazamentos.
  • Transmissão: substituição de homocinéticas, semieixos, retentores e verificação de fluido do câmbio.
  • Interpretar manuais técnicos e diagramas elétricos.
  • Cumprir os procedimentos de segurança e ambientais estabelecidos pela montadora.
  • Preencher corretamente OSs, apontando serviços realizados, peças trocadas e tempo aplicado.
  • Participar de treinamentos técnicos BYD e manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias.
  • Utilizar corretamente os equipamentos, ferramentas especiais e EPI’s.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • ✔️ - Ensino Médio Completo.
  • ✔️ - Desejável: Curso Técnico em Mecânica Automotiva, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas (SENAI ou equivalente).
  • ✔️ - Tempo: Mínimo de 2 anos em oficina mecânica ou concessionária automotiva.
  • ✔️ - Segmento: Veículos leves.
  • ✔️ - Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com veículos híbridos e elétricos, e vivência em processos padronizados de concessionárias.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios

  • VR R$26,00 Por dia / VA R$221,00 Mês

description:
AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE MARKETING PLENO - FOCO EM COMUNICAÇÃO DE MARCA NA YDUQS.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Analisar dados e indicadores relacionados ao comportamento e à jornada dos alunos, identificando oportunidades para aprimorar a comunicação com a base estudantil;
  • Traduzir campanhas e iniciativas de marketing desenvolvidas para captação em comunicações relevantes também para alunos ativos;
  • Propor ideias, ações e projetos de comunicação voltados ao engajamento, relacionamento e experiência do aluno;
  • Planejar comunicações direcionadas aos alunos, definindo objetivos, mensagens, formatos, canais e públicos de cada ação;
  • Sugerir novos formatos, canais e abordagens de comunicação que ampliem o impacto das mensagens junto aos estudantes;
  • Estruturar o fluxo de comunicação com os alunos, iniciando demandas de envio e articulando com os times responsáveis pela ativação das bases e disparo das comunicações;
  • Solicitar, acompanhar e garantir a execução dos envios de comunicação nos diferentes canais (e-mail, CRM, notificações, entre outros), assegurando a implementação das ações planejadas;
  • Monitorar os resultados das comunicações realizadas e gerar análises e relatórios com insights para otimização das próximas ações;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de marketing, experiência do aluno, acadêmico e demais equipes, garantindo consistência e efetividade na comunicação com esse público.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Jornalismo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Boa capacidade analítica para interpretação de dados e geração de insights;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e habilidade de adaptação de linguagem para diferentes públicos;
  • Interesse por comportamento do consumidor, experiência do aluno e estratégias de comunicação.

Diferenciais

  • Familiaridade com análise de dados e métricas de comunicação;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CRM, automação de marketing ou plataformas de comunicação;
  • Vivência no segmento educacional.

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: Barra da Tijuca - RJ (Edifício Montreal)

Jornada de trabalho: 40 horas semanais, de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, com opção de flexibilidade das 8h às 17h.

Na YDUQS você vai encontrar

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados (pai, mãe e irmãos (as). Permitindo até três bolsas simultâneas;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família, com o colaborador responsável pela coparticipação;
  • Assistência odontológica opcional, para cuidar da sua saúde bucal;
  • Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição com opção de escolha para se adequar às suas necessidades;

  • Dress code flexível para promover a nossa diversidade;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Universidade Corporativa no nosso portal exclusivo, Educare;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento, hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.

Vice President, Auditor – Internal Audit

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting‑edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Auditor to join our Internal Audit team. This role is located in Rio de Janeiro.

Responsibilities

  • Participating in risk‑based audits covering Fund Administration, Custody, and Corporate Functions, from end‑to‑end planning through reporting, in line with Internal Audit methodologies and standards.
  • Executing thorough and accurate testing to assess adherence to internal policies, audit standards, and applicable Brazilian and global regulatory requirements.
  • Identifying and promoting opportunities for the use of data analytics, automation, and AI to enhance audit coverage and efficiency.
  • Leads risk‑focused planning, fieldwork and reporting, in accordance with Internal Audit policies, methodologies, and standards to identify meaningful issues, risks and other exposures.
  • Responsible for ensuring testing is adequate and accurate to allow an evaluation of adherence to company policies and procedures, audit methodologies, and all applicable regulations.
  • Demonstrates skills and understanding of businesses and processes through flowcharting, work papers, analysis, issue identification and discussions with management and auditees.
  • Identify meaningful issues impacting business and operations under review, partnering with management to ensure appropriate remedial action has been taken to address the issues identified. Follow‑up of audit actions and test their implementation.
  • Applies advanced analytical problem‑solving skills and leads others in solving complex issues and identifying innovative solutions.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across the Brazil businesses, second line functions, and global Internal Audit teams.
  • Apply knowledge of financial institutions and regulations daily, participate in relevant training, and share insights with the audit team.
  • Contributing to continuous risk assessment and monitoring activities, remaining alert to emerging risks and regulatory developments impacting the Brazil platform.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience or hands‑on interest in applying data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies to audit activities, including the ability to interpret and challenge analytics outputs to drive risk‑based insights.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience required.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
  • Solid experience in Internal Audit or the relevant specialty area (Risk, Compliance, or Controls), with the ability to operate within a global audit framework.
  • Strong knowledge of the financial services industry, including preferably exposure to fund administration and/or custody activities.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to engage in audits, reporting, and collaboration with international stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate issues and risks to stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
  • Additional skill requirements include understanding of the applied and interpretation of analytics results for Audit, critical thinking and problem solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively, and exercise professional judgment.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CIA, CPA, CFA) are preferred.

Benefits and Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay‑for‑performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

Awards

For over 230 years, the people of BNY Mellon have been at the forefront of finance, expanding the financial markets while supporting investors throughout the investment lifecycle. title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Missão do cargo:

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;

Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in-house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers' compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in-house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in-house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy.

The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment-related and labor-related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in-house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in-house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters.

Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership.

The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective-bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi-legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed.

Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers.

Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions.

Responds to University officials' request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility.

Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University.

Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems.

Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action.

Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures.

Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies.

Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics.

Ability to participate effectively in fact-finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations.

Ability to articulate the University's position, listen and negotiate effectively.

Superior verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision.

Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines.

Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction.

Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience.

All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Product Specialist - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Job Description

Biocomposites is an international medical devices company that engineers, manufactures, and markets world leading products for use in infection management in bone and soft tissue. Based in Keele, UK, it has global operations across Europe, USA, Argentina, Canada, China, and India. Biocomposites is a world leader in the development of innovative calcium compounds and bone cements for surgical use. Its products regenerate bone and target infection risks across a variety of specialties, including musculoskeletal infection, orthopaedics, trauma, spine, foot and ankle, podiatry, and sports injuries. Biocomposites products are now used in over one million procedures per annum and sold in more than 100 countries around the world.

The Role

The Biocomposites Product Specialist’s primary goal is to drive compliant sales growth of the Biocomposites’ product portfolio across our core specialties of orthopedics, trauma, spine, and foot and ankle in priority target accounts. This will be achieved by motivating, educating and supporting the appropriate distributor sales representatives in their sales activities including product training, hospital and surgeon target selection and hands‑on, in‑field sales support. It will also include regularly travelling to target hospitals to engage with surgeons, peri‑operative teams, and hospital staff directly to promote correct product use and adoption. The position reports directly to the Country Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Achieve sales revenue targets by product and specialty in assigned Region.
  • Drive adoption in existing accounts and new users in hospitals within assigned territory. This will be achieved by directly selling to targeted surgeons as well as educating, supporting, and selling through local distribution teams.
  • Exhibit confidence in product knowledge and science to handle competitive threats.
  • Leverage data and local insight to prioritize local territory needs and activities.
  • Utilize business planning tools, data and information to effectively work the territory while achieving goals through set quarterly MBOs.
  • Enhance relationships with key stakeholders within distributor network to influence resource allocation and prioritize focus on Biocomposites’ products.
  • Ensure all distributor sales representatives sell compliantly and use our approved product messaging.
  • Provide continuous training and education to all distributor sales representatives in all vertical markets.
  • Identify and engage new distribution partners in our key vertical markets.
  • Regularly update distributor network on market conditions, challenges, product innovations, competition and pricing, as directed by Region Sales Manager.
  • Provide surgeon product feedback and identify surgeon challenges and opportunities to inform new product development.
  • Demonstrate OR and product competency to assist surgeons and peri‑operative team with technical guidance.
  • Routinely assist distribution with product expertise and support during sales calls.
  • Provide product in‑services and continuing education seminars to hospital staff.
  • Cultivate relationships with key surgeons, residents, fellows and KOL’s, within geography.
  • Support local customer dinner meetings and scientific exchanges.
  • Support Region Sales Manager in business planning.
  • Achieve quarterly territory Objectives as directed by Region Sales Manager.
  • Clinician and Distributor continuing education via sales trainings, current medical journals and clinical papers.
  • Timely and accurate expense reporting by way of Concur.
  • Ability to travel and conduct overnight stays within the geography as needed.
  • Ability to travel to US headquarters in Wilmington, NC for business meetings as needed.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of documented medical or B2B sales success grounded in sales process training.
  • Advanced level of English.
  • Documented sales success and career progression.
  • Demonstration of competency in presenting technical information.
  • Ability to work with highly diverse groups.
  • Ability to present and educate provided materials.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Documented ability to influence decision makers.
  • Medical Device/Orthopedics Industry experience.
  • Basic knowledge of human anatomy is preferred.
  • Understanding of Hospital OR policy and procedures preferred.

title: Analista de Processos & Performance de Supply Chain
description:
Empresa empregadora TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda

Tipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI)

Experiência Mínimo 6 anos

Context & Environment

  • Atividades realizadas em um ambiente de forte crescimento e transformação, incluindo Lapa South West, blocos exploratórios e grande portfólio de ativos não operados (Libra, Iara & Atapu, Sépia).
  • Operações em ambiente de alto custo e regulamentação local rigorosa, com processos de aprovação longos e exigentes.
  • Forte exposição a ativos Operated by Others (OBO), especialmente nos campos de Libra e Iara, exigindo relações confiáveis e de longo prazo com a Petrobras.
  • Atividades com alta complexidade técnica, custos elevados e metas exigentes, demandando rigor em governança, gestão de riscos e disciplina de execução.

Atividades

Principais Atividades:

O(a) colaborador(a) deve realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à integridade das pessoas, preservação do meio ambiente e eficiência energética, contribuindo para a redução de emissões de GEE dos ativos da Companhia.

  • Revisar, atualizar e garantir o cumprimento de procedimentos, templates e padrões de Supply Chain, assegurando alinhamento com diretrizes do Grupo, JOAs e normas internas.
  • Monitorar processos ponta a ponta e riscos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Construir e validar KPIs e dashboards; monitorar KPIs do Métier e preparar informações quando solicitado pelo HQ.
  • Consolidar o Procurement Plan, revisar e acompanhar sua execução, apoiando a equipe de Supply Chain no uso do plano; facilitar o acesso do HQ ao documento.
  • Apoiar o follow up contratual no SAP e ações de melhoria.
  • Atuar como suporte de primeiro nível em SAP MM/WEBI/Power BI.
  • Validar modelos de dados e master data, facilitando o uso do SAP para temas de procurement.
  • Consolidar dados de mercado e avaliações de fornecedores, incluindo realização de Due Diligence; apoiar compradores nas avaliações.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de um banco de dados de fornecedores de referência.
  • Executar SOX, acompanhar DOA e regras de governança; preparar materiais e apoiar exercícios de auditoria.
  • Organizar treinamentos, onboarding e canais de comunicação da área de Supply Chain.
  • Facilitar comunicação interna entre Supply Chain e outras entidades da afiliada para temas de procurement.

Responsabilidades

  • Manter procedimentos e templates padronizados para assegurar práticas consistentes de Supply Chain.
  • Monitorar processos ponta a ponta para identificar melhorias e riscos operacionais.
  • Fornecer KPIs e dashboards para garantir visibilidade clara de performance.
  • Realizar análises com SAP e ferramentas de relatórios para suportar decisões.
  • Garantir acurácia dos dados e conformidade ao validar master data, regras de governança e requisitos de auditoria.
  • Executar Due Diligence de fornecedores, avaliando integridade, conformidade e indicadores de risco.

Perfil do Candidato

  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: 5+ anos na indústria de O&G, com no mínimo 3 anos em Contratos & Procurement.
  • Competências técnicas: Gestão avançada de materiais; conhecimento de materiais EP (Perfuração, Completação, Subsea, HSE); sólido entendimento de MRP e MAP (contabilização de estoque).
  • Sistemas: SAP MM avançado, WebI, Power BI avançado, Excel avançado; familiaridade com Ariba e conceito UNISOL é um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Português fluente e inglês avançado.
  • Competências pessoais: Análise e resolução de problemas; planejamento e priorização sob pressão; trabalho em equipe; rigor e atenção aos detalhes; boa organização; comunicação eficaz e habilidade de influenciar stakeholders; forte capacidade de apresentação.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Functions

To provide coordination of client-centered services that link clients with substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health with coordinated care and psychosocial services.

Working closely and collaboratively with the HUH inpatient and Consultation-Liaison and Addiction Medicine Consult services and the ambulatory Mental Health Clinic (Behavioral Health Clinic) teams, the Care Coordinator assesses clients’ needs and support systems; facilitates timely, coordinated access to and continuation of medically appropriate substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health care health and support services; assists in expediting appropriate discharge from inpatient facilities, as medically appropriate, and assists in preventing unnecessary hospitalizations; and establishes and maintains relations with case managers, healthcare providers, social services and other agency representatives to bridge the gaps between health, social service, entitlements and other systems.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in development and implements protocols for coordinating the substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health services for individual clients or patients with substance use or co-occurring psychiatric and substance use disorders.
  • Provides care coordination services to a caseload of patients/clients, as assigned by the PI, Project Director, or Care Manager Coordinator.
  • Operates as a liaison between the Departments of Psychiatry and Community and Family Medicine, Social Work and the DC Department of Health and other community groups.
  • Ensures that patients receive necessary follow-up substance use or psychiatric disorder treatment and medical treatments.
  • May accompany patients to the initial or follow-up visits and may help arrange transportation and scheduling of appointments.
  • Conducts intake and follow up assessments of clients’/patients’ behavioral health and medical/functional status; structural vulnerabilities; psychological; educational; financial; and individual support needs.
  • Reviews all initial client bio-psychosocial assessments and reassessments.
  • Attends department trainings and meetings relevant in ongoing effort to increase knowledge and skills to work effectively with clients.Attends annual and mandatory compliance Program training, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy training, maintains adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Works on behalf of patients receiving medications for opioid use disorder treatment to improve the system of care by identifying service gaps and identifying services that are needed and ensuring that these services are provided in a courteous and dignified manner.
  • Maintains confidentiality of patients, their families and the staff.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of the care needed for individuals receiving MOUD or other substance use disorder treatment.
  • Knowledge of community resources to establish referral systems with community agencies to facilitate coordinated management plans for patients and their families.
  • Ability to express ideas clearly using appropriate language in communicating with a wide range of health, socioeconomic, and cultural groups.
  • Competence in both oral and written English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with clients and their family members and other treatment or service providers; physicians, staff, University and Hospital personnel, and the general public.
  • Proficiency in both oral and written English.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field, or 2 or more years of experience in the field.

title: Referee Operations Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Under the guidance of the FIFA Refereeing (Zurich) and Team Services (FIFA27), the Referee Operations Manager will lead the planning and delivery of all referee operations during FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ and related refereeing events. The role is to ensure the excellence of all services required for match officials, fully aligned with FIFA’s Refereeing Requirements, and to guarantee seamless coordination between FIFA Refereeing, Local Team Services and all relevant functional areas. The Referee Operations Manager will be based in the FIFA 27 headquarters in Rio de Janeiro during the planning stage and at the Referee Base Camp during tournament time.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure that all operational plans, services, logistics and procedures for Referee Services fully comply with FIFA Refereeing Requirements, delivering the highest standards of service quality to match officials.
  • Operationalise technical and operational needs from FIFA Refereeing into practical, efficient and integrated operational solutions.
  • Lead cross‑functional coordination with all relevant functional areas (FAs) to ensure full integration of Referee Services into tournament operations.
  • Represent Referee Services in operational meetings, workshops, and multi‑stakeholder sessions, ensuring alignment, follow‑up of action points, and consistent internal communication.
  • Coordinate closely with FIFA Refereeing, FIFA Team Services and FIFA27 Team Services for all operational and administrative matters.
  • Assist in preparing and refining Referee Services operational concepts, policies, procedures and service plans.
  • Drive operational readiness for all referee‑related events, including workshops, seminars, test events, inspection visit or any other preparatory activities.
  • Act as the dedicated Refereeing representative for stadium and training site operational planning, ensuring full integration of referee‑specific requirements.
  • Lead the planning and delivery of VAR referee operations at the International Broadcast Center, in coordination with Technology, Broadcast Operations and VAR leadership.
  • Organize the FIFA Referee Cup and Pre‑competition Seminar prior to the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™.
  • Work closely with Workforce, Volunteers and HR on planning, recruiting, onboarding and training temporary staff and volunteers dedicated to Referee Services.
  • Identify, secure and coordinate local football teams to participate in daily practical training sessions with referees.
  • Prepare and deliver training materials, operational manuals and readiness exercises for Referee Services staff and volunteers.
  • Monitor the Referee Services budget in close coordination with Team Services, ensuring efficient and responsible use of resources.
  • Lead the overall project planning for Referee Services, managing timelines, milestones and deliverables across all team members.
  • Based at the Referee Base Camp, the Referee Operations Manager will transition to a Referee Liaison Officer (RLO) role and will be responsible for:
  • Reporting to and assisting FIFA Refereeing, as required, with all local arrangements (matches, training sessions, meetings, spectating referees, etc).
  • Cooperating with all FAs and service providers to support referees and FIFA Refereeing daily.
  • Coordinating the local players requested for the practical training sessions with the referees.
  • Exchanging information, in particular any last‑minute changes to the daily program, with training site authorities and all FAs involved in the referees’ daily operations.
  • Organizing social activities for the FIFA Refereeing delegation team during the competition, as required.
  • Supervising and coordinating the Referee Services support staff, including the Venue Referee Liaison Officers and volunteers at each stadium.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Excellent communicator with strong planning, organizational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver at a high standard.
  • Able to work closely and collaboratively with others, while being self‑motivated and able to work independently.
  • Able to manage a group of people working on the same projects and, as required, coordinate people in other functional areas to contribute to projects.
  • Capable of making decisions using problem‑solving skills and exercising sound judgment to achieve results.

Why join us?

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Sr. Director of IT for Auxiliary Enterprises, the IT Support Specialist is responsible for providing general IT support across all Auxiliary Enterprises. IT‑related tasks may include setting up, managing, and troubleshooting technology systems used by each business unit associated with the Office of Auxiliary Enterprises. Duties may include providing end‑user support with laptop and desktop computers; providing support for card readers, printers or other IT and computer peripherals; assistance with Howard University physical and Wi‑Fi network; diagnosing and resolving hardware problems including specialized hardware such as point‑of‑sale terminals, building controllers, laundry machine interface devices, OR parking ticket issuing hand‑held terminals; configuring and updating system and application software; and tracking down data and communication issues.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides technical support for various hardware used across Auxiliary Enterprises including point‑of‑sale terminals, printers, laptops, desktop computers, cameras, card readers, scanners, contactless readers, monitors, kitchen‑display systems, time clocks, building/laundry controllers, building/laundry readers, point‑of‑sale terminals, peripherals, and other equipment used by contractors and employees in Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Provide Tier‑1 support for Dining Service point‑of‑sale terminals and peripherals.
  • Level Review diagnostics and assess the functionality and efficiency of systems.
  • Work with system providers in the support of various applications.
  • Work with Howard University ETS to Implement, enforce and support security measures.
  • Monitor security certificates and company compliance with requirements.
  • Monitor systems to ensure they are operating as expected.
  • Provide technical support to Auxiliary Enterprises contract staff and troubleshoot computer systems and peripheral equipment used by Auxiliary Enterprises contractors.
  • Install and update company software and hardware as needed.
  • Anticipate and make recommendations regarding the replacement or updating of computer items.
  • Assist with installation, upgrades, and the disposal of IT‑related products.
  • Coordinate with ETS and off‑prem/cloud‑based vendors to ensure that Auxiliary Enterprises systems and data are backed up and back‑ups are verified and able to be restored when necessary.
  • Assemble, install, and configure systems and components per vendor specifications but within the policies, procedures, and best practices of Howard University, HU Enterprise Technology Services, and Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Stay updated regarding the knowledge and skills needed to keep up with rapid advancements in computer technology.
  • Maintains logs of activities and completed work and provides reports to the Sr. Director. Specifically, Laundry System Status and the Auxiliary Enterprises IT Asset List. Additional logs may be assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, networking, and related technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Windows Operating system.
  • Ability to develop plans for resolving and implementing technical and operational problems.
  • Ability to work independently, to plan and prioritize activities that may span several locations on campus.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical problems due to complex system interfaces.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to operate in an office environment and in the field (various locations across all campuses of Howard University).
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the community.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or closely related field and one year relevant experience;

or equivalent combination of a total of five (5) years combined relevant education and experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $60,000 - $69,000

title: Software Engineer - L3 Support
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer – L3 Support to work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux‑based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep‑diving difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountableYou value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux – kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equality and Diversity

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another.   • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.

We’d like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we’re working towards that goal, click here .

title: Workday System Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid.
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management.
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions.
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions.
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption.
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday.
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements.
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements.
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies.
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases.
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality.
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root‑cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge‑base articles.
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes.
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross‑functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment.
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed.
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen.
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution.
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices.

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services.
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation.
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements.
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions.
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution.
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines.
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail.
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing.
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Strong problem‑solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience.
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training.
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $110,000 - $125,000

title: Software Engineer - Python - Cloud - graduate level
description:
Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Position

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu on public clouds.

The quality and stability of Ubuntu is critically important, as it is available on every public cloud. You’ll work with teams across Canonical and major cloud partners to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu cloud images. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

This role requires quality‑oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability across a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The role involves creating and managing Ubuntu images; therefore, experience in configuring apt, knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions worldwide. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. Ubuntu is used for a wide spectrum of users, from mission‑critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with them in mind.

Role Outline

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end‑system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on‑premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Game Presenter
description:
Our client is looking for a Game Presenter with Brazilian Portuguese to join their dynamic team in Malta.

This is an exciting opportunity for a confident and engaging individual who thrives in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering a high-quality gaming experience, ensuring professionalism, accuracy, and outstanding customer interaction at all times.

As a Game Presenter, you will be the face of the games, responsible for creating an enjoyable and welcoming atmosphere for players while maintaining strict adherence to gaming procedures and regulations. Our client values teamwork, attention to detail, and a passion for delivering exceptional service.

Job Description

Presenting the tables and games in a professional manner and in accordance with company procedures and gaming regulations. Ensuring that the highest standards of efficiency and customer satisfaction are maintained. Achieving increasingly high standards of performance by collaborating with the gaming inspector and supervisor.

Role and Responsibilities

  • To call “no more bets” in good time, to make sure that the call is observed always and that no more bets are accepted, added, removed or changed once they have been given and accepted.

  • To notify the supervisor immediately of any equipment malfunction.
  • To collaborate with the supervisor to improve the games and other related matters.

  • To maintain the highest possible standard of customer relations and company reputation.
  • To give appropriate handover at change of shift.
  • To conduct any other reasonable tasks as may be directed by the employer from time to time, in accordance with company exigencies.

Person Specification (Skills; knowledge; experience; attitude)

  • Smart appearance;
  • Good command of English;
  • Basic IT knowledge;
  • Be a team player;
  • A flexible approach to work;
  • Previous experience in a similar job and gaming knowledge will be considered an asset.
